# Dion Group

> Dion Group builds its own software products and custom software for other companies: business software, AI solutions, websites and online shops. Based in Greece, working internationally in English, German and Greek.

Dion Group makes and runs its own products (Axon TMS for truck yards and terminals; Aegis, AI document processing, in development) and takes on client projects: custom web applications and internal systems, AI assistants and document automation, workflow automation and integrations, customer portals and booking systems, and company websites and online shops. One team handles a project from the first conversation to launch, then hosts, maintains and improves it. Areas of experience: logistics and transport operations, terminal and yard management, document-heavy workflows. Prices for products and projects are given on request.

## Products
- [Axon TMS](https://dion-group.com/tms/axon.html): Terminal and yard management system for truck operations. One live record per truck from plan to exit: loads planned from the ERP, driver self check-in by QR code without an app, approval in one click, plate and container matched at the gate, dock calls and loading timers, document checklist (CMR) and automatic release slips. Light and dark mode; desk, wallboard and phone. Pricing on request.
- [Aegis](https://dion-group.com/#work): AI document processing for logistics, in development. Reads invoices, CMRs and delivery notes and turns them into checked, structured data (supplier, dates, route, VAT, totals).

## Services
- [Custom software](https://dion-group.com/#services): Web applications, operational platforms, dashboards and internal tools built around how a company already works.
- [AI solutions](https://dion-group.com/#services): AI assistants that read documents and email, automations that remove retyping between systems, AI features inside existing software.
- [Websites and online shops](https://dion-group.com/#services): Company websites, online shops, booking systems and customer portals in English, German and Greek.
- [How a project runs](https://dion-group.com/#how): From the first call to launch, then hosting, maintenance and improvements.
